name: Acid Strongbox Trap
disable: DC 22 Thievery check (expert) to harmlessly bleed away the magical field or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 20) to dispel it.

items.name: Acidic Spray
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches the strongbox directly or with a held tool

---

Effect The trap deals 4d8+10 acid damage in a 15-foot cone in the direction of the triggering creature (DC 21 basic Reflex save).

text: An invisible magic field around the strongbox releases a spray of acid when disturbed.
